text:
emily-ops: Quick heads-up: a visiting ceramicist is dropping off an oversized teapot for a tiny hands-on demo at 3pm. They'll sign in at the lobby and need guest badges. It's fragile & heavy — treat as artwork. :tea:
frontdesk-bot: New delivery recorded 14:47 from ClayShip (AWB: CL-4422). Label: 'TEAPOT - FRAGILE'. Carrier ETA ~15:05.
frontdesk: Badge printer hiccup this morning, it jammed and is spitting blanks. I can process check-ins manually if needed but might need a workaround for proper badges. :grimacing:
matthew: Printer log snippet I grabbed:
```nERROR: PAPER_JAM 0x43
Action: press FEED + open tray
Status: WAITING_FOR_USER
```
anya: That printer eats labels. If it dies, use the 'Temp Badges' kit in the top drawer (lobby desk). There are adhesive stickers and a hole-punch. Scissors are in supply closet A.
jess: Also we need to clear a small staging spot for the teapot and a stool for the artist. Can someone shift the round cafe table by the window? It's light but a pain to wrestle.
sam: I can move the table and bring a two-wheel dolly. Do you want the teapot near the front couch or next to the high-top?
emily-ops: Front couch is better so watchers can sit comfortably. Please label the parcel 'ART - DO NOT STACK' and put it in secure cabinet B until the artist arrives.
frontdesk: Parcel placed in cabinet B, labeled DO NOT STACK. Attempted to print temporary badge but printer jammed again; handing out printed visitor slips with a stamp as Plan B. Vintage vibes. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
matthew: If someone is up for it, try this quick printer reset that worked once: open tray -> remove rollers -> blow compressed air -> re-seat rollers -> hold FEED for 5s. Low effort, sometimes magic.
anya: I'll come help with the badges and the sticker kit. Jess, could you grab a felt pad or something soft for the teapot to sit on?
jess: Yep grabbing a small felt pad from supply closet C and a roll of clear tape. Also bringing extra name stickers.
emily-ops: Thanks team! Office ops ballot: move the lobby couch one foot to the right to improve sightlines for the demo. React +1 if okay.
sam: +1
matthew: +1
anya: +1
frontdesk: +1, I'll make the tweak when I move cabinets around.
emily-ops: Final plan: Sam moves table + brings dolly, frontdesk secures parcel and handles check-in (paper slips if printer refuses), Jess brings felt pad & stickers, Matthew will attempt the reset if needed. Setup meetup at 14:55. :clock2:
frontdesk-bot: Reminder set: "Artist teapot dropoff" at 14:55 in #lobby (fragile).
